name: Dances with Destiny
source:
You are a young woman struggling to maintain her family archives and working part-time at a local market. On the night of your debut into society as an adult, you attend the Ball of Indigo Flowers. While there, you encounter a mysterious man who sweeps you off your feet and charms you with his good manners. He disappears before you can talk to him more. Suddenly a man drags you onto the dance floor, and you realize he’s your childhood friend, believed to have died in a war between humans and ghouls. Shocked and overwhelmed, you decide to attend a party at his mansion the following night. Once again, you encounter the mysterious man who noticed your scent, and his enigmatic but handsome brother. While out on the patio, you’re suddenly attacked by a man with glowing red eyes...a ghoul! Your childhood friend saves you, but you find yourself drawn into the world of ghouls, learning more about them and the war. Three handsome men with their own personalities and opinions accompany you, each one vying for your attention. But questions and danger plague you. What is this power you have that quells a ghoul’s violent rage? Who is the person trying to kill you? And who will finally claim your heart?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.highlifeghoul]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年輕女子，一邊努力維護家族檔案，一邊在當地市場打零工。在成年後初次踏入社交界的那一夜，你參加了靛藍花舞會。席間，一位神秘男子令你怦然心動，他彬彬有禮的舉止讓你著迷。可還沒來得及多聊，他就消失了。

突然，另一名男子將你拉入舞池，你這才發現，他竟是你以為早已死於人類與食屍鬼戰爭的青梅竹馬。震驚而不知所措的你，決定參加第二天晚上在他宅邸舉辦的聚會。你再次遇見了那位留意到你氣味的神秘男子，以及他同樣神秘俊美的兄弟。

來到露臺上時，你突然遭到一個雙眼泛著紅光的男人襲擊……是食屍鬼！青梅竹馬救下了你，而你也就此被捲入食屍鬼的世界，逐漸瞭解他們與那場戰爭。三位性格與觀念各異的俊美男子陪伴在你身邊，都想贏得你的關注。

然而，疑問與危險始終纏繞著你。你那能平息食屍鬼狂暴怒意的力量，究竟是什麼？是誰想殺死你？最終，又有誰能贏得你的心？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.highlifeghoul]Google Play[/url]]
